subject: Convert Intro to Iterative POC Sprint — prework & travel constraints
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@stratusanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: convert scheduled demo into iterative POC sprint

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for booking time with our team next week. Quick update on our side — our VP of Product and two execs who were planning to join the demo are traveling the week you scheduled and are unlikely to make the live session. Given that, we'd prefer to convert the single demo into an iterative POC-style engagement that lets execs review asynchronously and still gives our engineers hands-on time.

What we have in mind:
- A 2-week iterative POC (scoping + runbook + validation) rather than a one-off demo
- Short daily 30-min syncs (M–F) for the first week and 2–3 focused sessions the second week
- Asynchronous sandbox/lab access so our team (and execs) can poke around on-demand
- A one-page prework checklist to accelerate the first sync

Can Redwood run this configuration? If so, can you share a prework template and an outline of roles (AE, solutions engineer, facilitator)? Also — we may need a travel/concierge note for our execs (they're in transit much of Nov 22–24).

Tom Benson (cc) will handle procurement questions. Happy to hop on a 15-min call to align.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of AI, Stratus Analytics
Aisha.K@stratusanalytics.com

--
Attachment: (none)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.k@stratusanalytics.com>, Tom Benson <tbenson@stratusanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: convert scheduled demo into iterative POC sprint

Hi Aisha — this is a great approach and totally doable. Thanks for the context.

Quick response to your asks:
- Yes, we can convert the planned demo into a two-week iterative POC with the sync cadence you suggested and on-demand sandbox access.
- I'll loop in our solutions lead (Marissa) and our facilitator (Jonas) to draft the prework and a proposed two-week runbook.
- We can also prepare a brief "travel concierge" note for execs with a short weekend-friendly summary and the key links they need.

Marissa / Jonas — can you confirm availability the week of Nov 30 for:
1) a 45-min kickoff to run through prework and objectives (we'll schedule at a time that covers PST/EST overlap)
2) daily 30-min syncs the following week (first week of POC) and 2–3 working sessions the second week
3) a shared doc for prework that we can push to Aisha today?

I'll propose calendar options to Aisha/Tom once I have your windows.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: convert scheduled demo into iterative POC sprint

Karthik / Jonas — available and we can run this as proposed. Drafted a compact runbook and a one-pager prework template (attached). Key notes:

- Proposed structure (high level):
  Week 0 (prep): distribute prework + grant sandbox access; 45-min kickoff (synchronous)
  Week 1: daily 30-min standups (tech blockers, data access), plus 90-min hands-on lab twice that week
  Week 2: focused validation sessions (two 60-min deep dives) + executive review slot (30 min async briefing + 30-min live recap)

- Roles:
  AE (Karthik) — program owner, customer updates, exec liaison
  Solutions Eng (Marissa) — lab design, prework, runbook owner, hands-on sessions
  Facilitator (Jonas) — run daily syncs, manage agenda and timeboxes

- Timezones: we'll aim for 11:00–12:00 PST for the kickoff to catch east coast and anyone in EMEA who can join early; daily standups at 09:30 PST (that covers late morning EST). Jonas — does 09:30 PST work for you to facilitate?

- Sandbox access/ops: we recommend the team share a handful of example prompts + a 2GB sample dataset (S3 link) so we can pre-stage. We'll provide basic scripts to validate latency/cost.

Attachments: poc-prework-template.md (stub), runbook-outline.docx (stub)

Link to shared plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcPocPlan

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
